name: save-token-jev
description: Jev-guided, verbatim context compaction for Claude Code.

apiKey.title: Jev API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: typesafe or openrouter. Leave unset to follow JEV_PROVIDER, then the available key.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Defaults to jev-latest for TypeSafe and typesafe/jev-1.13 for OpenRouter.
